profile: Helen of Troy sells consumer products through brands including OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey, Vicks, Braun, Honeywell, PUR and Revlon. Its Home & Outdoor segment offers food preparation and storage, cooking, cleaning, organization, beverageware, coolers, backpacks and travel gear. Beauty & Wellness products include hair styling appliances, grooming tools, personal care, nail care, humidifiers, thermometers, purifiers, heaters and fans. Customers include retailers, distributors and direct consumers.
